sourceNote: Names, descriptions, grades and hidden flags are the official list as published on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Every guide below is written in our own words from the official description and has not yet been checked in the game.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours, so treat it as the finish line of the whole route, not a task of its own. Follow the nine chapters in order and mop up collectibles and activities before the finale, because the 100% completion trophy is the longest grind on the road here. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission Gone Fishing; it unlocks as the story moves on and cannot be missed. Use it to learn the fishing controls, since a later fishing challenge against Cal builds on the same mechanics. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock automatically when the story advances, so just keep playing the main missions in order and this one lands on its own. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it is unmissable: complete the chapter's story missions and it unlocks at the chapter's end. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Keep to the main mission path and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes; side activities can wait until the route's later chapters. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale chapter, so by the time it pops you should have the story trophies banked and can turn to the side content in Chapters 5 to 8. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. Do the missable-flagged side trophies first if you can, because once the finale is done the cleanest moment to mop up is the post-story free roam this route saves for Chapter 9. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run when the story offers it. It is a story mission trophy, so it unlocks by playing the mission, not by any special approach inside it. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions tend to be the longest in a chapter, so go in with a full stock of supplies and expect a multi-stage job rather than a quick hit. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Another story mission trophy: play the mission when it appears in Chapter 3 and it unlocks on completion. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. The name hints at a high-profile target, so expect a set-piece mission; finishing it is all the trophy asks. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. Airport missions usually mean tight spaces and heavy security, so move carefully and use cover rather than rushing the terminal. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. The operation name suggests a large combat sequence; complete it in the story order and the trophy follows. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, which in past games means every story mission, stranger strand, activity, collectible set and challenge the checklist tracks. This is the real platinum gate: the route is built so that by Chapter 9 only this and the platinum itself should be left. Check the in-game stats page regularly to see which completion category is still short. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida: jumps, near misses, long airtime and the like all count toward the running total. The count builds passively while you drive everywhere for the rest of the route, so chase it deliberately only near the end, using fast cars and the stunt jumps you find along the way. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: sample one of everything the map offers, from races to arcade games to bowling, rather than mastering any single one. Work through the activities chapter and tick each type off as you try it; this trophy is the sampler that introduces the rest. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is a skill grind, not a checklist: practice one weapon class at a time, learn each range's target pattern, and save the hardest challenges for when your aim and weapon handling are at their best. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's shortcuts and the drone's handling before racing for the win, and clear locations one by one so you can see which are left. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races, so variety matters more than repetition: each race counts once, and re-running a race you already won adds nothing. Spread your wins across race types and locations, and pair this with the drone races and stunt driving already on the route. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. The opening mission teaches the fishing basics, so take Cal on once you are comfortable with the cast and reel timing, and keep your line tension steady instead of yanking. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Pick the shortest game in the arcade first and learn its rules; finishing any single game is enough, so choose the one that suits you rather than the flashiest cabinet. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's stranger strand. Stranger strands unlock across the map as the story advances, so check back for new Andy missions between story chapters and finish the strand before the finale. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's stranger strand. Work through Kenton's missions as they appear and finish the strand in Chapter 5, while stranger content is still opening up. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's stranger strand. Billy's strand is one of the six character strands in Chapter 5; finish it alongside the others so no strand is left dangling into the endgame. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. There are more strands than the 8 needed, so pick the ones whose missions suit you and finish them fully; a strand only counts when its final mission is done. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's stranger strand. Like the other character strands, Randy's missions appear as you explore Leonida, so keep an eye on the map for his marker between story beats. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's stranger strand. Finish Tyrone's strand in Chapter 5 with the other character strands, before the route turns to collectibles and heists. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. The spots are spread over the whole map, so pair this with the exploration trophy and visit them district by district instead of criss-crossing the state. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Unique hunts usually mean tracking one specific animal in one specific place, so follow Bret's clues rather than hunting at random, and take the shot cleanly when the animal shows itself. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so collect them as you travel for other trophies and trade or hunt down the missing cards set by set; completing a set, not just holding cards, is what counts. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations. This is a volume grind: make WAiNK a habit at every new place you visit, and the count will climb steadily through the exploration chapters without a dedicated farming session. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges overlap with nearly everything else on the route, from stunts to races to collectibles, so this one fills itself in as you play; check the challenge list late in the route and target the easiest unfinished ones. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it. Flagged missable because it needs your partner present: try it during a story stretch where you are paired up, break line of sight, and hide until the stars clear rather than fighting the whole police force. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level. Flagged missable because it needs your partner and a hot streak: pick three shops close together, move fast between them, and keep the wanted level alive but manageable rather than letting it drop or spike. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you drive or encounter counts, so this fills itself in if you keep switching rides instead of using one car for everything; check your vehicle log late in the route to see how close you are. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Flagged missable because the setup matters: wait for a fight with a cluster of enemies, trigger Combat Focus when they are grouped, and chain the takedowns before the focus runs out. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport: get a plane off the ground without going through the normal channels. Flagged missable because the airport is a restricted area in normal play: look for a plane on the tarmac, get aboard, and take off before security closes in. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos, the tanks, in whatever way the game lets you. Flagged missable because tanks appear in specific encounters: when Rhinos roll in, use heavy weapons or explosives and keep moving so their cannons cannot pin you down. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Flagged missable because stealth is the whole requirement: scout the store, move when staff and cameras are looking away, take the goods quietly, and leave before any alarm. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Flagged missable because each vault is a full job: plan the entry, crack the vault, and have an escape route ready before the alarm brings the heat. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Flagged missable because the truck and its guards are a live encounter: hit it fast, grab the cash, and break away before backup arrives. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive and walk into every named area on the map; the exploration chapter is built around this, so tick areas off district by district and use the map pins to see what is left. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Learn which gang runs which operation and hit one of each; the trophy counts gangs, not operations, so one per gang is enough. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the beachfront in Vice City, order a cocktail, and take in the view; it is one of the gentlest trophies on the list and a good first stop on the route. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a vehicle straight through the showroom glass and out the other side; the game wants spectacle here, so commit to the exit instead of creeping through. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play through a bowling session at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Follow through on your throws the way the alley asks; a full game at the alley is all it takes. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach a partnership moment with mass appeal. This reads as a story-flavoured partnership beat, so play the duo missions and let the partnership moments land as the story serves them up. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices that matter; PlayStation tracks a count toward 500 for this one. Flagged missable because choices can be one-time: when the game offers a real decision, pick deliberately and keep playing, since the count builds across the whole story. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try at something you failed the first time. Flagged missable because it needs a failed first attempt: if you fail a challenge or mission beat, retry it right away instead of reloading an old save, and the second success should pop it. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange in Leonida. This is the route's oddity trophy: keep your eyes open while exploring, especially in out-of-the-way places, and something strange should find you. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by from a moving vehicle. Flagged missable because the setup is specific: drive slowly past a target, swing the melee attack at the right moment, and let the vehicle's motion do the work. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Launder bills steadily through the contacts the story introduces; the total builds over time, so start early and keep feeding bills in rather than saving it all for the end. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Big purchases count fastest, so buy vehicles, weapons and property upgrades as you play and the total will climb; check your spending tally if you are close near the end of the route. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages cost serious money, so save for them through the money chapter and buy them as they become available; each one also gives you somewhere to keep the vehicles the route asks you to discover. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find ten different vehicles, open the app, and register each one; any ten count, so use the varied rides you already discover for the vehicle trophy. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: On the Spot
